verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is an API-bearing compliance case-management platform, so scoped agent credentials are a fair question. The only credential evidence is that API Keys can be managed under organization settings (docs-13), with no documented scoping, per-key permissions, or least-privilege controls. The developer docs are password-gated, so nothing further can be verified; plain organization API keys are an adjacent feature, not scoped credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
